narrative.scqa_md:
CI Financials is a $224.0B in assets under management asset manager regulated by OSC (Ontario Securities Commission) with 2,932 employees. A 26.0% multi-year growth rate and a trajectory the analyst classifies as accelerating give it the balance sheet to fund transformation [E-018]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 1.9/5. The deepest capability gap is Metadata Management & Data Catalog at 1.2/5 against a 2.5 peer median [E-103].

Next is SMS & Mobile Marketing at 1.2/5 against a 2.5 peer median [E-113]. Third is Content Personalization at 1.3/5 against a 2.5 peer median [E-026]. The issue register adds run_manifest.json missing — required Layer 2 contract artifact (critical severity). The issue register adds contradiction_log.csv missing — Layer 2 contract artifact not generated (high severity).

The pattern is corroborated across the assessment's evidence index [E-013]. The question for CI Financials is whether to close Metadata Management & Data Catalog first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. CI Financials should lead with nCino (80/100 fit) against Life Event Detection, then sequence Tableau behind it. Closing Metadata Management & Data Catalog to the peer median alone is worth 1.3 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain.
